audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for Week 4 garment-detail recognition with exact alignment between script and answer key.
audio_prompts.script: Look at the four garment cards. Number one: This is a white shirt. It has a collar, long sleeves, and three buttons on the front. Number two: This is a black jacket. It has a zipper, two pockets, and long sleeves. Number three: This is a blue skirt. It has a waistband, pleats, and a simple hem. Number four: This is a red dress. It has a round neckline, short sleeves, and a zipper on the back.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One adult teacher or Fashion Design classroom instructor speaking clearly to beginner learners.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Warm, direct, and easy to follow, with a short pause after each numbered description.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an available OpenAI or ChatGPT voice at generation time that sounds like a supportive classroom teacher.
